sentences.text:
Mohammad Chand Hashmi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9
April, 2025

Author: Prakash Padia
Bench: Prakash Padia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:51686
Court No. - 33
Case :- Writ - C No. - 10369 of 2025
Petitioner :- Mohammad Chand Hashmi
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shashi Prakash Giri,Shree Prakash Giri

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel on behalf of respondents- State.
2.

The petitioner has preferred the present writ petition inter-alia with the following prayer:-
"(i) Issue a suitable writ, order or direction in the nature of CERTIORARI to quash the impugned order dated 05.03.2025 passed by respondent no.2 in appeal dated 17.01.2025, whereby, cancelled the food registration license no. 22723128000659 issued to the petitioner.
Mohammad Chand Hashmi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95924011/
1 (ii) Issue a suitable writ, order or direction in the nature of MANDAMUS commanding and directing the respondents' authorities to allow the operation of the meat and meat products/food category in pursuance of the license (registration)
no.22723128000659 for location of Ward No.44 situated at Jyoti Nagar, Mathura Bangar, Tehsil and District Mathura."

entities.text: Mohammad Chand Hashmi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It is argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that against the order of suspension of license for food business activity, petitioner preferred an appeal before the respondent no.2-Assistant Commissioner (Food), Food Safety and Drug Administration, District Mathura, which was numbered as appeal/2024-25/581 the same was rejected by the respondent no.2 vide order dated 05.03.2025 hence present writ petition.

entities.text: Assistant Commissioner (Food), Food Safety and Drug Administration, District Mathura
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: 4. From perusal of the record it is clear that till date no final decision has been taken in the matter and only the license of the petitioner for food business was wholly illegally suspended.

5. In this view of the matter and also in the interest of justice, without interfering with the order dated 05.03.2025, the petition is disposed of with the direction to the authorities concerned before whom matter is pending consideration to take a decision, strictly in accordance with law,
expeditiously and preferably within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

Pramod Tripathi  Mohammad Chand Hashmi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95924011/
